title: Service Interval Overdue by Reference
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watch:service days_since_service=* service_interval_years=* reference_number=*
| eval interval_days=service_interval_years*365
| where days_since_service>interval_days
| sort - days_since_service
| table reference_number brand days_since_service interval_days
description: Flags watches whose days since last service exceed the manufacturer-recommended interval.
value: Overdue service on automatic movements risks magnetization damage and resale value loss at sale time.
implementation: Log `days_since_service` and recommended `service_interval_years` per reference and review quarterly.
visualization: Table of overdue references ranked by days past interval.
grandmaExplanation: It watches watches that are past due for a service based on the recommended interval.
